selected_script.angle: Anxious pet calming bath alternative - quick wipe down without water for a stress-free cat.
selected_script.hook: Does your pet turn into a ninja to escape bath time?

scene_01.visual: Introduce bath struggle, show the PawFirst glove.
scene_01.voiceover: If your pet hates bath time as much as mine does, you need to see this. The PawFirst no-rinse cleaning glove is an absolute lifesaver for quick cleanups.

scene_02.visual: Detail the texture and wearing it, wiping pet.
scene_02.voiceover: It’s a textured, pre-moistened glove that fits right on your hand. You just stroke your cat or dog, and the soft pearl texture lifts away dirt and odors instantly.

scene_03.visual: Result, happy pet, dispose of it.
scene_03.voiceover: No water, no rinsing, and no stressed-out pets. It detangles, cleans, and gives them a soothing massage. Grooming just became our favorite bonding time. Try it today!

broll_coverage.visual: Close up of taking glove out of blue pouch, putting it on, wiping cat's paw, disposing.
